notes.title: TATSUJIN hits Steam Feb 13th!
notes.content:
You read it right, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/834040/Game_Tengoku__TATSUJIN/]Tatsujin will release on Steam[/url] next week!
The store page is open now, and the DLC will release around 17:00 PST.
We'll have a celebratory sale and a contest too!

Contest prizes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/1efdbb1df90f785eb96d911a6821a2fbecf02ed1.png[/img]

[b]How to participate[/b]
Simply play Time Attack's Stage 1 at any time during the contest and record a score online.
Only new or updated scores recorded during the contest will be valid, but multiple entries/characters are acceptable.

[b]Rules[/b]
Duration: Feb 14th ~ 28th 11am (Japan time.approx 13th 5pm ~ 27th 6pm PST)
Options: default settings only
Character: Take your pick!*
*prizes may vary depending on character used.
More details next week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/834040/Game_Tengoku__TATSUJIN/

The DLC features the Super Fighter from Tatsujin/Truxton, playable in Arcade Mode +, two new tracks for Time Attack (original arcade stage 1 theme and a remix) and the Sound Test and a new entry into the Data Mode HD menu so you can learn more about Tatsujin/Truxton from the over-enthusiastic Yuki Ito (voiced by Kumiko Nishihara).

In order to faithfully re-create Tatsujin's play experience, the Super Fighter plays differently from the other characters: powerups cycle between three colours, the colour coresponding to a weapon type and options are added automatically at a certain power level. More info in the manual, [url=https://gameparadise2017.com/manual/en/data/07_13.html]here![/url]

notes.title: Game Tengoku Ver1.08 update
notes.content:
Today's update includes:

[list][*][b]Fix for missing sound playback[/b]
This should enable those of you with Asus Xonar Essence STX II and similar cards to play with sound and fix sound related crashes too.
[*][b]Fixed Story Replay unlocks in Classic Mode [/b]
The 'Bonus' story should now unlock once all other Chapters have been unlocked.
[*][b]Fix to enable access to Sound Test menu[/b]
The menu will now be accessible, but to listen to DLC voice/music, you will need the DLC in your Steam library.
[*][b]Fix for Driving World's background[/b]
Some of the clouds were not displaying correctly; this should be fixed.
[*][b]Fix for UI display glitches[/b]
The bonus gauge and some other UI elements should now display correctly all the time.
[*][b]Other minor fixes[/b][/list]

As always, if you have any problems related to this release, please check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/663130/discussions/0/1488866813759788530/?ctp=5]this thread[/url] out or contact us via games@degica.com

notes.title: At Last! The release date is here!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/8f8d4fb045acd621336ca7c76d381765b67f666d.png[/img]
We've kept you waiting without news for too long, but we can at last reveal the digital release dates for the international version: 
[b]November 30th, 2018![/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6wF1xNMUVSY
That's just over two weeks away and, as promised we'll be releasing the Special version in place of the standard release; any current owners of either the Steam version or PS4 (EU or US) will receive this as an update on its release!

What the special version means is...[list][*]new remixes for every character in Time Attack (Arcade Mode+)
[*]new Clarice bombs
[*]and a new sound test for you voice actress fans [/list]

Plus, the long-delayed localisation means the fully-voiced Data Mode HD is now subtitled, so you non-Japanese fans can finally experience the depths of Pig's dishonesty and marvel at Clarice & Homura's jovial banter (hint; they don't get on!)
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/4b0c7ca4448c7e15afee1ddcee008e5ffafe6059.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/9f36d33816b50830c39c0bc093fb1fe707206ee2.jpg[/img][/url] Click Me!

...And understand the offbeat, gag-filled story, of course!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/fb6e09a164f299832609774c15c2740c6a9ddbe4.jpg[/img]

Jeynus, Selia and the gang can't wait to make their debut in English, so make sure you don't miss them!

Hirohiroki was the winner, but we haven't been able to post any updates UNTIL NOW! As you can see, the develpment team have been hard at work preparing the new bomb for use in game!

[h1]Localisation Update[/h1]

notes.title: Clarice Bomber illustration contest results!
notes.content:
That's right, the results of the illustration contest we ran in December are in!
The first prize, if you recall, was that the winner's illustration would be immortalised in the game as a bomb for the DLC character Clarice ([url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/745910]released today![/url]).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/db7e3194d4f4ae86ea7fe79cf234a323957f2dfe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Tengoku Ver1.03
notes.content:
We just released an update adding some common feature requests and also also fixing a few minor bugs.

Today's update includes:

[h1]New Bonus Gauge and borders[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/c1231debb8fa74fa2468d295fc45fd72edb0e07e.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Bonus Gauge
Added a new gauge to show the remaining bonus time after picking up a bonus item. The position can also be adjusted by pressing RSB (press in the
 right stick).
[*]Brightness control
Added the ability to adjust brightness in-game. Pause the game and hold LB+RB and use left and right on the directional pad to adjust.
[*]Change border images
Added the ability to change border images in-game. Pause the game and hold LT+RT and use left and right on the directional pad to change.
[*]Fixed several minor issues.
[/list]

As always, if you have any problems with the game, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/663130/discussions/0/1488866813759788530/]please tell us here[/url].

notes.title: Release Updates and DLC!
notes.content:
[b]Release Updates[/b]
The Japanese version of Game Tengoku CruisinMix is coming later this month and the English implementation is coming right behind it, in early 2018!  Of course this means the game can be purchased in JP at anytime and the EN will be a part of an update in the near future!  The ORIGINAL Game Tengoku team is working HARD on implementing the localization, aiming for the highest quality and ensuring the original is done justice.

[b]Clarice DLC![/b]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/35c279754f4cff95219a83dff31efb5a8143238d.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/51191289ec76c27eb29b5c9533758c13b687b91c.png[/img][/url]
The 15 year old star of the Jaleco classic, City Connection (or Crusin), travels the world in her beloved ClariceCar to find the man of her dreams. Her ClariceCar has a wide firing range and mid-level power, making it great for beginners. Hoping to beat off Momoko, her own bomber, the “Ultra Explosive ClariceBomber”, features a pin-up image of herself.

[b]Homura Banto DLC![/b]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/d7cd80c762febae42c83b7124c02e653e9cf587b.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/c419c347ec9ac7bcda37eb2cdc8d655e2d347e0f.png[/img][/url]
Remember Bases Loaded?  If so, have we got the DLC for you.  Introducing Homura Banto, the first ever mascot that resulted from a bug in a classic NES baseball game.  Can you decipher the name and guess the bug?  Nah, I bet you have to look it up, n00b.  Homura's character design is courtesy of none other than Kenichi Sonoda! (Suchie Pai, Riding Bean, Gunsmith Cats).

[b]Extra Voices DLC![/b]
A pack of extra voice clips, recovered and remastered from the original voice recording, but previously unused, will will be available for download!
  
Prices and release dates for all DLC have yet to be determined, but Clarice and Homura will both be playable in Arcade Mode +!

notes.title: Game Tengoku developers interview
notes.content:
Famitsu Online published the first part of an interview with the development team recently. 

[h1]Interviewees[/h1]
Nobuhiro Yoshikawa - Producer & president of City Connection
Masahiro Arai - Chief game designer
Takanori Kazaana - Assistant game designer
Nozomu Akiyama - Main Programmer

https://www.famitsu.com/news/201709/04140830.html

[h1]Overview[/h1]
They talk about... [list]
[*]How CruisinMix came about
The team met up when City Connection were putting together the 3 disc soundtrack release for Game Tengoku
[*]Why the Saturn version was chosen over the arcade?
Yoshikawa-san wanted to do a Saturn port, but thought it would be impossible so asked about the arcade version. The team replied they could probably get the Saturn version working.
[*]The troubles involved with the port
Locating and recovering the master data and source code for the Saturn version was far from easy!
[*]The Claris DLC
A new character, added from scratch and recreated by the original Game Paradise designer, pixel by pixel.
[/list]
.. amongst other things.

Unfortunately, we can't offer a full translation, but hopefully, we'll be able to arrange an interview with them all nearer release!
